articles.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
articles.description: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
articles.description: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
articles.description: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
articles.description: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz, Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
articles.description: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
articles.description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
articles.description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
articles.description: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.
articles.author: Marina Temkin

articles.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
articles.description: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
articles.description: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis
